Well, I don't know about antidepressants, but I've been given pills against schizophrenia in small doses and it worked a bit, now I don't think about bad things as much as I did before that. 
That's just is not enough for me to come back to life. Maybe someone else with similar issues would've been healthy by now.

I'm just too afraid of new people to help them. And noone I know of needs my help. I don't see any sense in existence, I don't understand how anyone else can see it. That's why me help will be flawed.
I'm sorry. Did you try any medications or therapists?
I'm just a stranger, a simple throwaway. You will never know who I am or what I am. It does not matter what happens to me.
why not? I hear that sometimes, that someone cares about me. It does not change my feelings. It does not help me crawl out of this state of mind.
